{{Quote|He swore fealty to Darth Nyriss a dozen years ago when she led an Imperial force into his sector to subdue a potential uprising.|Sechel, to Scourge, of Ugroth|<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]],<ref>''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' indicates that the events depicted in the first part of the novel take place two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[3956 BBY]]. In the novel, [[Sechel]] states that the subjugation happened "''a dozen years ago''", thus the date [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]] can be derived.</ref> the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] dispatched an [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial force]] under the command of a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Darth Nyriss]], with the objective of subduing a potential uprising of a '''group''' in a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Ugroth's sector|sector]] under the rule of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Ugroth]].<ref name="Revan" />
